installCommand: npm install --global corepack@0.35.0 && corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@11.17.0 --activate && cd ../.. && pnpm install --filter @repo/web... --frozen-lockfile --strict-peer-dependencies
buildCommand: cd ../.. && test "$(pnpm --version)" = "11.17.0" && node -e "if (process.versions.node.split('.')[0] !== '24') process.exit(1)" && pnpm turbo run build --filter=@repo/web
